title: fix(sdk-python): omit rejected temperature in schema repair

files.patch:
@@ -67,6 +67,35 @@ def _is_transient(error_str: str) -> bool:
     return any(pattern in lower for pattern in TRANSIENT_PATTERNS)
 
 
+def _rejects_temperature(model: str) -> bool:
+    """Keep the Go SDK's default-mode temperature policy for repair calls."""
+    model = model.strip().lower().rsplit("/", 1)[-1]
+    if len(model) >= 2 and model[0] == "o" and model[1] in "0123456789":
+        return True
+    if model == "gpt-5" or model.startswith("gpt-5-202"):
+        return True
+    families = (
+        "gpt-5-mini",
+        "gpt-5-nano",
+        "gpt-5-pro",
+        "gpt-5.2-pro",
+        "gpt-5.4-pro",
+        "gpt-5.5",
+        "gpt-5.6",
+        "gpt-5-codex",
+        "gpt-5.1-codex",
+        "gpt-5.2-codex",
+        "gpt-5.3-codex",
+        "claude-opus-4-7",
+        "claude-opus-4-8",
+        "claude-opus-5",
+        "claude-sonnet-5",
+        "claude-haiku-5",
+        "claude-fable-5",
+    )
+    return any(model == family or model.startswith(family + "-") for family in families)
+
+
 async def _ai_schema_repair(
     text: str,
     schema: Any,
@@ -131,12 +160,17 @@ async def _ai_schema_repair(
         # Bail rather than guess; the existing retry path will handle this.
         return None
 
+    # GPT-5.1/5.2/5.4 accept temperature by default; preserve zero for them.

+
     try:
         response = await asyncio.wait_for(

+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "model",
+    [
+        "o3-mini",
+        "openai/gpt-5",
+        "openrouter/anthropic/claude-opus-4-7",
+        "claude-opus-5",
+        "gpt-5.5",
+        "gpt-5.1-codex",
+        "gpt-4o",
+        "gpt-5.1",
+        "gpt-5.2",
+        "gpt-5.4",
+        "claude-sonnet-4-6",
+    ],
+)
+async def test_ai_schema_repair_omits_rejected_temperature(model):
+    # Match the Go SDK policy: these default-mode models still accept zero.
+    accepts_temperature = model in {
+        "gpt-4o",
+        "gpt-5.1",
+        "gpt-5.2",
+        "gpt-5.4",
+        "claude-sonnet-4-6",
+    }
+
+    async def complete(**kwargs):
+        if not accepts_temperature and "temperature" in kwargs:
+            raise ValueError("400: temperature is not supported")
+        assert kwargs.get("temperature") == (0.0 if accepts_temperature else None)
+        assert kwargs["model"] == model
+        return _make_litellm_response('{"name": "repaired", "count": 7}')
+
+    with patch("litellm.acompletion", side_effect=complete) as completion:
+        result = await _ai_schema_repair(
+            "name: repaired, count: 7", _Schema, {"model": model}
+        )
+
+    assert result == _Schema(name="repaired", count=7)
+    completion.assert_called_once()
